messages:
maria: 👀 Alert from audit pipeline - new IAM binding detected against prod project. role=roles/owner, member=serviceAccount:ci-deploy@redwood-svc. first_seen ~ 03:12 UTC.
jake: on it, linking logs. saw spike in KMS decrypts around 03:10-03:18 UTC for key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/primary-key`.
neha: thanks. can someone run an audit log filter for SetIamPolicy and for serviceAccount create/delete events?
maria: running now: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:ci-deploy@redwood-svc' --limit 50` -> returns 1 entry from 03:11 UTC, requestor=ci-deploy, origin=pipeline-ops.
alex: deploy-bot posted pipeline #432 at 03:09 UTC. `deploy-bot: pipeline 432 finished SUCCESS (triggered by ci-deploy)`
jake: output shows the binding was added by a pipeline step in infra-deploy, but the step used a service account token. unclear if this was a legitimate config change or compromised token.
neha: immediate containment: remove the owner binding, disable the SA token, and rotate KMS access. who can remove the binding now?
maria: I'm running the removal: `gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member='serviceAccount:ci-deploy@redwood-svc' --role='roles/owner'` -> success.
alex: also submitted IAM deny on the SA: `gcloud iam service-accounts disable ci-deploy@redwood-svc` (blocked).
jake: for KMS, I created a new key version and disabled the old primary-key version v3 -> old version disabled, new version v4 active. I also rotated the key material and updated Vault mapping for services we know.
maria: logged actions to incident timeline. NOTE: there was ~120 decrypt ops in that 8-minute window. Need to enumerate which principals called KMS and correlate with pipeline runs.
neha: I'll run `gcloud kms keys versions list ... --filter='state:ENABLED'` and cross-check logs. Also start a quick IAM audit for any recently created service accounts in the last 7 days.
secops-bot: alert -> suspicious-activity: high-kms-decrypt-rate (key=primary-key) severity=high. Incident created: INC-2026-0319-07.
alex: we should assume CI creds compromised until proven otherwise. Rotate any tokens that pipeline uses, revoke all long-lived tokens. I'll open a ticket to rotate CI secrets in Vault and update pipeline to use ephemeral tokens.
jake: noted. tagging infra-team and pipeline owners. @neha please prepare a short handoff for day shift with what we did and recommended next steps.
maria: handoff draft: 1) Owner binding removed. 2) SA disabled. 3) KMS key rotated (v3 disabled, v4 active). 4) Enumerate decrypt callers + pipeline runs (in progress). 5) Rotate CI credentials in Vault + enforce ephemeral tokens. 6) Full audit for SA creations past 7 days. 7) Confirm no suspicious egress or data exfil patterns in storage/bigquery within same time window.
neha: I have it. handing to day oncall @alex with notes and links to logs: https://console.logging/redwood/queries?incident=INC-2026-0319-07 . Next actions for day: finish decrypt-caller list, run credential rotation playbook, interview pipeline owner for recent infra changes, schedule KMS key rotation validation for dependent services.
maria: tagging sec for postmortem: mark as Sev2 until we confirm blast radius. Add post-incident action: lock down any owner-level automation and require PR approval for infra IAM changes.
alex: taking handoff. I'll run through decrypt callers and contact pipeline owner. leaving this thread pinned to ops channel. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks team. closing war-room. please update INC ticket with any new findings.
deploy-bot: pipeline 433 queued by ci-deploy (blocked) – manual approval required.
neha: last note — snapshot logs and export audit logs to secure bucket before 12:00 UTC. I'll attach the links to the INC ticket.
alex: received. handoff complete.
